title: Options After Hitting Into a Red Penalty Area
question: Your ball lands in a red penalty area. Which of the following relief options is available for a red penalty area but not for a yellow penalty area?

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies, if possible.
Drop a ball within two club-lengths of where it last crossed into the area, for one penalty stroke.
Replay the shot from your previous spot, for one penalty stroke.
Drop anywhere on the course for one penalty stroke.

explanation: Only red penalty areas allow the option to drop a ball within two club-lengths of where it last crossed into the area, with a one-stroke penalty. This option is not allowed for yellow penalty areas.
imagePrompt: A left-handed teen boy about to drop a ball within two club-lengths of the edge of a red-staked penalty area, with water clearly visible and red stakes marking the edge.
imageAlt: Left-handed teen golfer preparing to drop a ball by a red-staked penalty area next to water.

issues: Prompt intent mentions 'left-handed teen boy,' but the sceneSpec and illustration correctly show a right-handed teenage girl based on the detailed requirements.
The posture and action clearly match the requirement to drop a ball from knee height, in line with golf rules.
Skin tone, clothing colours, and hat all match the description.
Only one golf ball is visible and there is no club in hand.
Red stakes and water are clearly shown.
